submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires when the current token completes a frequent, strongly predicted local collocation set up by the immediately preceding one or two tokens (e.g. modal plus main verb as in 'must contain', verb or preposition plus 'the', 'because' or 'capital' plus 'of', subject plus its characteristic verb as in 'Water boils', determiner plus noun as in 'The cat', or 'ORDER BY' plus a column name). It responds to the (trigger, completion) pair just read rather than to either token alone, fires across unrelated topics whenever such a pair occurs, and is unaffected by tokens after the peak.
